objective: Exercise an on_reject fix chain: builder, independent reviewer, and a third-identity fix attempt, all evidence-only with zero budget.
constraints: Evidence-only; no repository:write and no cloud:change.
Builder, reviewer, and fixer are three different roles.
Abstract lane resources only; no absolute host paths or secrets.

tasks.title: Initial canary build subject to independent review
tasks.instructions: Write score-runs/{run_id}/on-reject-build.json and return path and sha256. On review rejection the conductor routes to SOR-fix.

tasks.title: Third-identity fix after review rejection
tasks.instructions: Apply review findings to produce score-runs/{run_id}/on-reject-fix.json. Do not reuse the original builder or reviewer identity. Return path and sha256 for independent re-review.
